THE SPLIT PLATE / RECIPE

Chipotle Chicken Quesadillas

Same chicken base, two builds. Adults get crispy carb-balance quesadillas with fajita veg and chipotle sauce. Kids get soft street taco tortillas with melted cheese and Primal Kitchen Special Sauce. Same cook window, zero complaints.

YIELD4 servings
TOTAL TIME20 min
COOK METHODSee method
EST. / SERVING~450 cal | ~40g protein
KEY TO SUCCESS: Simmer broth until just reduced — filling should be coated, not swimming.

Ingredients

PROTEIN

  • 10 oz cooked chicken (pre-cooked only)
  • 1-1.5 tbsp taco seasoning
  • 1/4 cup chicken bone broth
  • Cooking spray (avocado oil)

Option 1

  • 6 street taco tortillas (3 per kid)
  • 2-3 oz regular cheddar
  • Primal Kitchen Special Sauce

ADULT BUILD

  • 4 carb-balance tortillas (2 per person)
  • 3 oz fat-free cheddar (rinsed)
  • 3 oz fajita veg (onion + peppers)
  • Smoky Chipotle Crema

Allergens: dairy, gluten.

STOP. Chicken filling is done. Split into adult build (quesadilla + fajitas) and kid build (street tacos, no fajitas).

Method

Shared base

  1. 1.FAJITAS (adults only). Spray pan, cook sliced onion + peppers 2-3 min. Add taco seasoning + bone broth. Simmer until reduced.
  2. 2.CHICKEN. Add pre-cooked chicken to fajita pan. Toss 1-2 min until coated and juicy.

Adult — Crispy Quesadilla + Chipotle

  1. 3.BUILD. Tortilla → cheese → chicken + fajitas → cheese → tortilla. Medium heat, 4-5 min per side. Light press.
  2. 4.SERVE. Slice, serve with chipotle sauce on the side.

Kid — Soft Street Tacos + Mild Sauce · Option 1

  1. 3.BUILD. Tortilla → cheese → chicken (no fajitas) → fold. Medium-low heat, 2-3 min per side.
  2. 4.SERVE. Soft tacos with Primal Kitchen sauce on side.

SPLIT PLATE SERVING

Adult — Crispy Quesadilla + Chipotle: Serve the adult portion as described above.

Kid — Soft Street Tacos + Mild Sauce: Serve the kid portion as described above.

Keys to success

  • Medium heat for adult quesadillas. 4-5 min per side. Don't rush or cheese won't melt.
  • Medium-low for kid tacos. 2-3 min per side. Soft, not crispy.

If something fails

Filling is watery / soggy: Didn't reduce the broth. Simmer until the liquid is mostly absorbed — filling should be coated, not wet.

Burnt tortilla, cold cheese: Heat too high. Medium for adults, medium-low for kids. Low + slow = melty inside, golden outside.

Cheese won't melt: Fat-free cheese needs help. Rinse it lightly, use low heat, and cover briefly with a lid.

Kids reject it: Skip fajitas for kids. Use regular cheddar (not fat-free). Serve with Primal Kitchen sauce, not chipotle.

Storage and reheating

Store: Assembled quesadillas keep 2-3 days in fridge. Reheat in air fryer.

Reheat: Air fryer 350°F 3-4 min to re-crisp. Don't microwave — kills the crunch.

Lasts: Filling: 3-4 days. Assembled: 2-3 days.
